findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_venues" is 2996 chars, far longer than this server's median (479). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_quote_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send the user's quote request to a venue or vendor through Düğün.com. The business will contact the user by phone or e-mail, and Düğün.com e-mails the user a co…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_articles · Private data: submit_quote_request · Public sink: submit_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_articles · Private data: submit_quote_request · Public sink: submit_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_venues" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
